author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices the five-finger home, a valley-shaped tune, the same pattern one step lower, long-short swing and song shape, playing together.

classes.title: Swing into your hand home
classes.goal: Hear the swinging song and rest one finger on each of the five home keys.

mathTarget.parentLine: Using the two black keys to find where the hand lives

classes.parentPrompt: Point to the two black keys, then help your child rest the thumb on C.
classes.childAction: Find the two black keys, put your thumb on C.
classes.bridge: C is the front door, left of the two black keys; five fingers, five rooms.

intro.caption: Swing your arms, long and short
intro.parentCue: swing together while the song plays

games.caption: One finger, one key
games.parentCue: Say the finger numbers together, one to five

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding the five-finger home on the keys.

classes.title: Down the valley, up again
classes.goal: Play the first line: from the top key down to C, then back up.

mathTarget.parentLine: The tune goes down to the bottom, then climbs back up

classes.parentPrompt: Draw a valley in the air with your child's hand: down, down, then up.
classes.childAction: Start on finger 5, walk down to the thumb, climb back up.
classes.bridge: The tune rolls down into a valley at C and climbs out the other side.

intro.caption: Down the valley, up again
intro.parentCue: Draw a valley in the air together

games.caption: Oh dear: down and up
games.parentCue: Say 'down' then 'up' as the hand moves

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: following a tune down and back up.

classes.title: Same shape, one step lower
classes.goal: Hear that the second line is the first line moved one key lower.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same little tune, moved one key lower

classes.parentPrompt: Play the line after your child's notes; you play the low B below C.
classes.childAction: Start on finger 4 this time and play the same shape.
classes.bridge: Same shape, one step to the left, like a shadow one stair lower.

intro.caption: Same shape, one step lower
intro.parentCue: You play the low B; your child plays the rest

games.caption: First line, then one step lower
games.parentCue: Ask: does it sound the same, but lower?

games.caption: Dear, dear: F, D, D, C
games.parentCue: Then you play the low B

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: spotting the same pattern, one step lower.

classes.title: Ask, ask, then answer
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and notice the last line lands home on C.

mathTarget.parentLine: The song asks 'oh dear?' and the last line answers

classes.parentPrompt: Shrug on each 'oh dear'; on the last line, smile and pat your lap on C.
classes.childAction: Play slowly; pat your lap when the song lands on C.
classes.bridge: Every 'oh dear' line asks a question; the Johnny line answers and comes home.

intro.caption: Ask, ask, then answer
intro.parentCue: Shrug on 'oh dear', smile on the ending

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing questions and an answer in a song.

classes.title: Long-short, long-short
classes.goal: Practise the swinging long-short notes slowly, then a little faster.

mathTarget.parentLine: A long note twice as long as the short one

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'loooong, short' with each pair while your child plays slowly.
classes.childAction: Play long, short, long, short, like a swing.
classes.bridge: Long notes swing out, short notes swing back: loooong, short.

intro.caption: Watch slowly
intro.parentCue: Say 'loooong, short' together with the notes

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: long and short notes, two to one.

classes.title: Two big swings a bar
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly while counting two big swinging beats a bar.

mathTarget.parentLine: Each bar has two big swings: one, two

classes.parentPrompt: Rock your child side to side, once on 'one' and once on 'two'.
classes.childAction: Play slowly and rock with two big swings each bar.
classes.bridge: Each bar is a swing going forward and back: one, two.

intro.caption: Two big swings a bar
intro.parentCue: Rock side to side together: one, two

games.caption: Tap the big swings
games.parentCue: Say 'one, two' on the big beats

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: feeling two big beats in a bar.

classes.title: Off to the fair
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music and keep going.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping your playing in time with the music

classes.parentPrompt: Sing the words along and nod on each beat; if a note slips, keep going.
classes.childAction: Play with the music and keep going to the end.
classes.bridge: The music is the busy fair; keep walking with it to the end.

intro.caption: Play along
intro.parentCue: Sing the words softly with your child

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping in time with the music.

classes.title: Teddy comes home
classes.goal: Play the whole song while waiting for teddy, then welcome teddy home.

mathTarget.parentLine: A song has a start, a middle and an end

classes.parentPrompt: Hide teddy behind you; on the last note, bring teddy home and cheer.
classes.childAction: Play while you wait; on the last note, welcome teddy home!
classes.bridge: The song waits and wonders, then the last note brings everyone home.

intro.caption: A song for teddy
intro.parentCue: Hide teddy behind your back for now

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song, start to end.
